run_ik_with_body_jacobian: run inverse kinematics using body jacobian to recover joint angles for a target end effector pose
run_ik_with_spatial_jacobian: run inverse kinematics using spatial jacobian to iteratively update joint angles toward a target pose
compute_delta_theta: compute the joint angle delta using jacobian pseudo-inverse and SE3 log of pose error
solve_ik_as_nls_optimization: solve inverse kinematics as a non-linear least squares problem using LevenbergMarquardt optimizer
create_autodiff_cost_function_for_ik: create an AutoDiffCostFunction with targeted_pose_error to minimize end effector pose error in Theseus
